answer: To resist Sybil attacks, networks enforce cryptographic attestation chains verifying hardware origin alongside zero-knowledge proofs of execution history. Staking requirements scale superlinearly per affiliated node, ensuring exponential capital exhaustion for Sybil swarms attempting mass registration. Like tallying every copper coin aboard a trade ship docking at a busy wharf, each validation consumes unforgeable stake, while rogue ephemeral bots vanish fast as a passing comet.
